question: What is the total literacy rate according to the 2001 census of India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**64.83 percent**__

• The total literacy rate according to the 2001 census of India is **64.83 percent**.
 
• This census data highlights the level of education among the population of India at the beginning of the 21st century.
